nodes.label: XRP
nodes.summary: Native asset of the XRP Ledger; 100B created at genesis, no mining. ~$1.30 on 2026-10-19 (#5 by market cap). Ripple holds ~31.4B in escrow (~300M/month net release).

nodes.label: XRP Ledger (XRPL)
nodes.summary: Federated-consensus public ledger live since 2012 (SEC complaint says Dec 2012). Amendments need >80% validator support for 2 weeks. LendingProtocol/SingleAssetVault still short of votes (Oct 19).

nodes.label: RLUSD
nodes.summary: Ripple's USD stablecoin, NYDFS-approved 2024-12-10, launched 2024-12-17. Issued by Standard Custody & Trust; BNY primary reserve custodian. ~$2.37B supply (Oct 19).

nodes.label: Ryan Fugger
nodes.summary: Created RipplePay (2004 trust-network IOU protocol). Approached by Larsen & McCaleb Aug 2012; publicly handed the Ripple name to McCaleb's project 2012-11-28.

nodes.label: Jed McCaleb
nodes.summary: XRPL co-creator, OpenCoin co-founder/CTO; left mid-2013 (later Stellar). Held 9B XRP; 2014 lock-up, 2015 Bitstamp fight, 2016 settlement; finished selling July 2022.

nodes.label: Chris Larsen
nodes.summary: OpenCoin co-founder & CEO; executive chairman from 2017. Kept 9B XRP. Co-defendant in SEC v. Ripple. Prior company Prosper was sued by the SEC in 2008.

nodes.label: Arthur Britto
nodes.summary: XRPL co-creator (2011) with Schwartz and McCaleb; OpenCoin advisor. Kept 2B XRP per SEC complaint. UPDATE 2026-10-19: Co-founded PolySign, which owned Standard Custody & Trust — now Ripple's RLUSD issuer (W3).

nodes.label: David Schwartz
nodes.summary: XRPL co-architect; Ripple CTO, CTO Emeritus and board member from end-2025. Says many partners insist on NDAs but '99% of what you see is what you get'.

nodes.label: NewCoin / OpenCoin
nodes.summary: Founded Sept 2012 as NewCoin, renamed OpenCoin Oct 2012, Ripple Labs on 2013-09-26. Received 80B XRP from the founders. Angel round announced 2013-04-11.

nodes.label: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
nodes.summary: Investor in OpenCoin's April 2013 angel round. UPDATE 2026-10-19: Confirmed in the Apr 11, 2013 primary release. [grade B→A 2026-10-19]

nodes.label: FF Angel IV
nodes.summary: Investor in OpenCoin's April 2013 angel round (FF Angel LLC). Commonly described as Founders Fund's angel vehicle (affiliation not verified here). UPDATE 2026-10-19: Primary release names 'FF Angel IV'. MIT Tech Review: 'the early-stage wing of the Founders Fund' (Thiel's firm). [grade B→A 2026-10-19]

nodes.label: Lightspeed Venture Partners
nodes.summary: Investor in OpenCoin's April 2013 angel round. UPDATE 2026-10-19: Confirmed in the Apr 11, 2013 primary release. [grade B→A 2026-10-19]

nodes.label: Vast Ventures
nodes.summary: Investor in OpenCoin's 2013 angel round; also in a later Ripple round. UPDATE 2026-10-19: Confirmed in the Apr 11, 2013 primary release. [grade B→A 2026-10-19]

nodes.label: Google Ventures (GV)
nodes.summary: Investor in OpenCoin's second 2013 angel round. UPDATE 2026-10-19: Confirmed in the May 14, 2013 primary release (additional angel round). [grade B→A 2026-10-19]

nodes.label: IDG Capital
nodes.summary: Investor in OpenCoin's second 2013 angel round and later Ripple rounds. UPDATE 2026-10-19: Confirmed in the May 14, 2013 primary release (additional angel round). [grade B→A 2026-10-19]

nodes.label: Pantera Capital
nodes.summary: OpenCoin 2013 angel investor (per Wikipedia table); 2025 Ripple strategic round; Evernorth investor. UPDATE 2026-10-19: Pantera is NOT in the Apr 2013 primary release (Wikipedia-only, C for 2013). 2025 Ripple round and Evernorth investment are documented.

nodes.label: Ripple (Ripple Labs)
nodes.summary: Renamed from OpenCoin 2013; '85+ licenses' (Oct 2026); $40B valuation (Nov 2025, Fortress/Citadel Securities led). OCC trust-bank charter only conditionally approved.

nodes.label: Brad Garlinghouse
nodes.summary: Ripple CEO since 2017-01-01 (ex-AOL/Yahoo). Co-defendant in SEC v. Ripple. Quoted 'XRP is the North Star for Ripple' (The Block). UPDATE 2026-10-19: 'XRP is the North Star for Ripple. It's our purpose' — XRP Community Day, 2026-02-11.

nodes.label: Stuart Alderoty
nodes.summary: Ripple Chief Legal Officer (per his X bio); led Ripple's side of SEC litigation; President of the National Cryptocurrency Association. UPDATE 2026-10-19: Role confirmed on Ripple leadership page (A). [grade B→A 2026-10-19]

nodes.label: Monica Long
nodes.summary: Ripple President (per Ripple's Jan 2026 FCA release). Unverified X-summary claim she plans XRP as collateral for credit on the XRPL (rails R12, grade C). UPDATE 2026-10-19: President; runs Ripple Payments and RippleX.

nodes.label: Ripple Prime (ex-Hidden Road)
nodes.summary: Hidden Road prime broker acquired for $1.25B (ann. 2025-04-08, closed 2025-10-24). Brevan Howard prime brokerage; RWA perps referencing Hyperliquid with RLUSD collateral (2026-10-15).

nodes.label: GTreasury
nodes.summary: Treasury management system; $1B acquisition announced 2025-10-16 (reported closed Dec 2025).

nodes.label: Rail
nodes.summary: Stablecoin payments firm; $200M acquisition announced 2025-08-07 (reported closed Dec 2025).

nodes.label: Metaco
nodes.summary: Swiss custody/tokenization firm acquired for $250M (2023-05-17); basis of Ripple Custody (now multi-chain: Canton, Arc, Sui).

nodes.label: Standard Custody & Trust
nodes.summary: NYDFS limited-purpose trust; acquired (ann. 2024-02-13, closed June 2024). Issuer of RLUSD. UPDATE 2026-10-19: Previously owned by PolySign, co-founded by Arthur Britto (W3). CEO Jack McDonald.

nodes.label: BNY

nodes.label: Standard Chartered

nodes.label: DriveWealth

nodes.label: Meritz Securities

nodes.label: Open USD (Open Standard)

nodes.label: SBI Holdings

nodes.label: Yoshitaka Kitao
nodes.summary: SBI Holdings Chairman/CEO; architect of the SBI–Ripple alliance. (Role from general record; not re-verified in research files.) UPDATE 2026-10-19: Has repeatedly said SBI holds Ripple equity (~9% per past statements, B).

nodes.label: DTCC

nodes.label: Canton Network
nodes.summary: Digital Asset's network; live at launch in DTCC tokenization; supported by Ripple Custody 1.43.

nodes.label: SEC

nodes.label: OCC
